Issue numbers, commit hashes, and `@mentions` are links on GitHub, GitLab, and every other forge, and plain text everywhere else.
Writing a Quarto document about a project means either losing them or writing every URL by hand.

`gitlink` recognises the same forms the platforms do and turns them into links, across GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Gitea, and Bitbucket.
It also draws a repository widget, with live star and fork counts, which is the one in the sidebar of this site.

## Installation

```bash
quarto add {{< var extension.reference >}}
```

This will install the extension under the `_extensions` subdirectory.
If you are using version control, you will want to check in this directory.

Or install it from your editor with [Quarto Wizard](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-wizard):

::: {.btn-group role="group" aria-label="Quarto Wizard installer options"}

[Visual Studio Code](vscode://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/install?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Install {{< var extension.reference >}} in Visual Studio Code using the Quarto Wizard extension."}
[Positron](positron://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/install?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Install {{< var extension.reference >}} in Positron using the Quarto Wizard extension."}

## Quick start

```yaml
filters:
  - path: gitlink
    at: post-quarto
extensions:
  gitlink:
    platform: github
    repository-name: mcanouil/quarto-gitlink
```

Then write references as you would in an issue comment:

```markdown
Fixed in #1, see also mcanouil/quarto-gitlink#1.
```

The repository is detected from the git remote when it is not given.

::: {.callout-important}
`post-quarto` is required, so Quarto resolves its own cross-references before this filter looks at the text.
:::

See the [Reference](reference.qmd) for every option, and the [Examples](examples.qmd) for the reference forms rendered.

## Where it works

Every output format for the links themselves.
The widget is HTML, since it fetches counts as the page loads.
